ContentGrouping.NoRulesYet: No content grouping rules have been created yet.
ContentGrouping.DeleteRuleConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this rule?
ContentGrouping.RulesDescription: Define rules to group page URLs into named content groups. Rules are evaluated in priority order (lowest number first). The first matching rule wins.
ContentGrouping.ReportDocumentation: This report shows metrics grouped by content group. Content groups are defined by URL matching rules in the admin settings.
ContentGrouping.MappingHint: A mapping partitions pages into mutually exclusive groups. Use separate mappings for different analysis granularity levels.
ContentGrouping.MappingConflictHint: Within one mapping, overlapping rules are rejected so one page cannot belong to two groups.
ContentGrouping.NewMappingHint: Create a new mapping name to build another page taxonomy without affecting existing mappings.
ContentGrouping.TestHint: Use this before saving to validate where a URL will land for the selected mapping.
ContentGrouping.PriorityHint: Lower number = evaluated first (0 is highest priority).
ContentGrouping.RequiredFieldsMessage: Group name and pattern are required.
ContentGrouping.UnmappedPreviewDescription: Preview pages that currently fall into "Others" for a selected period/date. This helps identify missing rules.
ContentGrouping.UnmappedPreviewEmpty: No out-of-mapping pages found for this period.
ContentGrouping.InvalidateDescription: If you have changed your content grouping rules, use this to invalidate cached reports for this website. Reports will be re-processed with the updated rules on the next archiving run or page load.
ContentGrouping.InvalidateSuccess: Reports have been successfully invalidated. They will be re-processed on the next archiving run.
ContentGrouping.InvalidateError: An error occurred while invalidating reports.
ContentGrouping.GroupTransitionsDescription: Analyze how visitors navigate between content groups. Select a group to see which groups they came from and which they went to next.
ContentGrouping.GroupTransitionsEmpty: No transition data found for this group and period.
ContentGrouping.TransitionsDateHint: Use the date picker and segment selector in the top navigation bar to filter the analysis. The page reloads automatically.
